The accepted baseline is `69ae099022c270469016a6a83f9f9ae13d98e320`. The production change invokes the already accepted direct-base `checkMovableLimits` helper for ordinary decorations. It leaves brace normalization, bar's Accent dispatch, annotation ownership and decoration `subsupOK` permission unchanged. It does not recursively change grouped or scripted descendants.

Their display outputs were already identical; all eight compiler trees now have the source direct-base fields. All other 56 SVGs remain byte-identical to the accepted baseline. The boundaries file is exact and baseline-bound. Twenty-two existing false under-decoration script errors remain pending the separate D071 permission fix, and two preexisting scripted-overline geometry mismatches remain separately recorded for source review.
